desc: Proposed first read-only block boundary after 108. Identify the one right-port removable sd device by USB IDs, capacity and sysfs ancestry; assert no nvme device. Read and hash only fixed GPT/header/partition sectors and compare expected identities. Do not mount any filesystem, replay a journal, run fsck, write, partition, or flash; known-ext4 mounting starts at 112. Exact reporter/artifact hashes, independent review, fresh approval, lease, and healthy rig required.
